kind: R5 browser-only settled complete Catalog layers

capture.colour: Original product THREE.NeutralToneMapping exposure 1 and Lebombo HDR yaw 1.6 for beauty; separate original shader/no-env fixed neutral background for face contribution diagnostics

navigation: Synthetic software row select dispatch through the product handler/open/retarget APIs; not hand click or headset tracking evidence. Catalog content is not mutated.

diagnostics.geometry: Actual position/normal/index arrays must exactly equal look.glassSlabGeometry(w,h,t,r,{tessellate:.002}) from the live product module; full bounds and front/back/side triangle categories must remain. Export hashes and counts. Compare actual bounds with reference geometry bounds, not nominal t: the product extrusion minimum can add 0.01mm beyond nominal thickness. Export nominal thickness, actual depth and difference separately.
diagnostics.shader: Exact vertex/fragment equality with live product glassMaterial factory, backdrop uniform object identity, original shader side/depthWrite, and no legacy cut-mask code/uniforms.
diagnostics.pixelContribution: Sample actual front, side or back triangle centroids below the title. Camera-facing triangles and body ray hits define isolated surface ROI; first-hit among all complete body meshes defines unoccluded scene ROI. Compare original shader to body absent under a separate no-env neutral background. Do not change geometry or shader to obtain a pass.
diagnostics.emptyRoiPolicy: If canonical overlap leaves fewer than24 unoccluded sampled body pixels, full-scene contribution is N/A for that level/view. All original geometry/shader and isolated full-body contribution checks remain mandatory. Never mutate Catalog to manufacture exposure. N/A must not be reported as full-scene contribution proof.
diagnostics.restoration: Exact original uOpacity/uniform snapshot, object visibility, HDR environment and complete original HDR beauty pixel readback after diagnostics.

matrixGate.rule: For each listed rear level in the same canonical fixture, at least one final view must have sceneApplicable=true, exposed ROI>=24, changed pixels>=20 and max RGB difference>=3. This gate is evaluated after all six current captures; one view receipt does not establish the complete matrix.

supported.runtimeEvidence: Only combinations recorded with passing capture.json count as validated; planned matrix or CLI support is not runtime proof

unsupported: Quest hand tracking or visual acceptance

historicalR4.retiredBehavior: foremost eye-ray hard mask and rear title .92

r5.mask: No legacy uRearMask/uCoverRect/uCoverRadius in actual shader or uniforms; full original slab retained

revisionReason.cause: Per-view scene contribution was required even when canonical front overlap fully occludes rear body samples. Angle had 19/16 changing samples under cap256, below unchanged minimum24.
changes: Increase uniform triangle sample cap from256 to512 without geometry/camera/material or minimum-threshold changes
Per-view full-scene contribution may be N/A only below24 exposed samples; each rear level of each fixture requires scene contribution in at least one final matrix view
